pro_course_detail.description:
I have lived a thousand lives.
I have witnessed words turn into a thousand worlds right before my eyes. I read. 

A few weeks back I travelled to Kabul, Afghanistan. I felt the impact of the exploding bombs as they obliterated the little hope that I had left that one day, my daughters will be free from laws that aim to keep them in bondage.  

Last night I had dinner with Buddha and we conversed about the meaning of life. He spoke of nirvana and eternal bliss which made me realise just how little I require to be truly happy. 
Once upon a time, I travelled back to the century in 1700.  My name was Nandi and I gave birth to a son, a king who would be known to the world as Shaka. The Zulu man that defeated the British army was armed with nothing but a spear and no shoes on his feet.

Literacy has the power to transform, it transcends boundaries and opens a million portals of possibility, It brings the world and history to us.
Knowledge is infinite, it is power and it is all found in a book. 
Let us cultivate the culture of reading.
Let us dare to walk in the shoes of others
Come along, let's go to places authorities would never let us. 

Join me for a reading session.

The founders of democracy and human rights realized that, hence, they established a universal law that states that conflicts will be resolved by courts and treaties.  
Using words as our weapons, we fight raging wars that continue to ravage our societies. 
Poverty, extortion, colonization, disease, these are all wars being fought with a pen.  
We live in an information society that thrives on communication, the exchange of words is what makes the financial industries, religious sectors, educational, entertainment, and many other sectors all possible. 

Through the use of words we have managed to unite mankind,  we are slowly progressing from the barbaric habit of fighting for peace and instead, we are resolving our differences and finding similarities as well as solutions through conversations.    

It is vital to be able to express yourself, especially in this ever-growing digital society.
Let me help, I do proofreading, editing and narrating.
